题解

思路：模拟法

  • 将输入的字符串按照字符 : 数量格式按顺序分割并保存。推荐使用链表、列表的容器数据结构保存，便于头插，效率高。后者后续使用双指针。
  • 循环遍历统计相同和不同字符即可。

python:
from collections import deque
import sys
​
# 解析压缩字符串，返回 deque 结构的 (字符, 次数)
def parse_string(s):
    res = deque()
    num = ""
    for c in s:
        if c.isdigit():
            num += c
        else:
            res.append((c, int(num)))
            num = ""
    return res
​
s1 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
s2 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
​
list1 = parse_string(s1)
list2 = parse_string(s2)
​
diff = 0
same = 0
​
while list1:
    ch1, cnt1 = list1.popleft()
    ch2, cnt2 = list2.popleft()
    compare_num = min(cnt1, cnt2)
    
    if ch1 == ch2:
        same += compare_num
    else:
        diff += compare_num
​
    # 将剩余字符重新插入队头
    if cnt1 > compare_num:
        list1.appendleft((ch1, cnt1 - compare_num))
    if cnt2 > compare_num:
        list2.appendleft((ch2, cnt2 - compare_num))
​
print(f"{diff}/{diff + same}")
​
